name: web-wine-tourism-site-over-black-and-white-bottle-wall
title: Winery search site with a vineyard photo hero over a monochrome wall of wine bottles
whatItIs: A greyscale photo of a wall of bottles behind a white browser-like page. The hero is a green vineyard photo with a serif headline, a search field with a red button, three stats (250+, 4.9, 3 500+) and below a section 'Best wineries' with photo cards.
whatItMeans: Warm and refined; the greyscale bottle wall makes the vineyard colour pop.
techniques: Use a monochrome themed backdrop around the UI.
Overlay a search bar on a photo hero.
Show three key stats in the hero.

vocabulary.definition: A greyscale image behind a UI.
A hero built around a search field.
Three key numbers in a row.
A deep red used for buttons.
